question: Does the best army depend on the ground? Every army against every other, twelve supply a side, on five grounds
notes: Strategic breadth. Each army costs twelve supply (a pikeman takes two), filling a side's one-tile places front to back; every pair meets on every map from both ends. If one army led on every ground, picking an army would be no decision; if one beat nobody anywhere, it would never be worth fielding. The armies are the factions' own units: the Citizens' trooper, marksman and pikeman, the Ravels' runner, slinger and buzzard.
